Metagenics at Priceline Pacific Fair

Yes, Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair in Broadbeach is a Metagenics stockist, with a selection of practitioner products on the shelf and anything else from the range special-ordered in. Our pharmacists can check a product against your medicines before you buy. Ask in store, or call us to order.

Reviewed by Jason Markey, owner and pharmacist · Updated 7 October 2026

Call (07) 5592 2099 Hours & directions

What is Metagenics?

Metagenics is a practitioner range, which means its products are usually recommended by a health professional after talking about your health and goals. The range covers general wellbeing, digestive health, energy, stress, sleep, sport and more.

Can you order in a Metagenics product you don’t have?

Yes. We keep a selection of Metagenics products on the shelf, and we can special-order anything else from their range. We’ll give you a call when it arrives. Delivery time depends on postage, so order a little before you run out. Ask in store or call us on (07) 5592 2099.

Why buy practitioner supplements from a pharmacy?

  • Checked against your medicines. Our pharmacists can check whether a supplement is suitable alongside any prescription or over-the-counter medicines you take.
  • Honest advice. If a supplement isn’t likely to help, or a GP visit is the better first step, we’ll tell you. The GPs at Help Medical are located inside our store.

Always read the label and follow the directions for use. Vitamin and mineral supplements should not replace a balanced diet.

Looking for other vitamins?

See our full vitamins and supplements range, including everyday, pregnancy and children’s products.

Common questions

Do you stock Metagenics in store?

Yes. Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair keeps a selection of Metagenics practitioner products on the shelf, and we can special-order anything else from their range.

Do I need a practitioner’s recommendation to buy Metagenics?

Metagenics is a practitioner range, so its products are usually recommended by a health professional. Ask our pharmacists whether a product suits you and your medicines.

How long does a special order take?

Delivery time depends on postage, so order a little before you run out. We’ll give you a call when it arrives.

Can I take Metagenics with my prescription medicines?

It depends on the product and your medicines. Ask a pharmacist to check whether a supplement is suitable alongside any prescription or over-the-counter medicines you take.

How do I order a Metagenics product?

Ask in store or call us on (07) 5592 2099 with the product name and we’ll order it in for you.
